title: Densities of weakly convergent density-represented top-dimensional currents converge against scalar test functions
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝⁿ = Euclid n an arbitrary set, c ∈ ℝ, Y_k ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n) and u_k : ℝⁿ → ℝ (k ∈ ℕ). Write e := (e_0, …, e_{n−1}) with e_i := EuclideanSpace.single i 1. Assume (i) Y_k(ω) = ∫_U u_k(y)·ω(y)(e) dy for every k and every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) (TestFormOn U n), and (ii) Y_k(ω) → c·∫_{ℝⁿ} ω(y)(e) dy as k → ∞ for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U). Then for every b : ℝⁿ → ℝ that is C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)), has compact support and satisfies tsupport b ⊆ U, ∫_U u_k(y)·b(y) dy → c·∫_{ℝⁿ} b(y) dy as k → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid n)) (c : ℝ) (Y : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n) (u : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ), (∀ (k : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Y k ω = ∫ y in U, u k y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid n) n) y (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Tendsto (fun k => Y k ω) atTop (𝓝 (c * ∫ y, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid n) n) y (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))))) → ∀ b : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) b → HasCompactSupport b → tsupport b ⊆ U → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ y in U, u k y * b y) atTop (𝓝 (c * ∫ y, b y))
